description: Landmark sequences (normalised x, y per frame; null = no hand) and the per-frame outputs of the gesture pipeline: raw count, confirmed count, change flag, relay states, latched finger states and the sum of the filtered pixel coordinates. Timestamps are frame_index / fps.

sequences.name: count_up
sequences.description: poses 0 to 5 held six frames each; each commits on its third frame

sequences.name: hold_on_loss
sequences.description: three fingers, then the hand leaves; relay 3 stays on

sequences.name: reset_on_loss
sequences.description: two frames of five, a gap, two frames of five: the run restarts after the gap

sequences.name: confirm_after_return
sequences.description: after a gap, a count needs three fresh frames

sequences.name: single_frame_flicker
sequences.description: one-frame excursions to another count never reach the relays

sequences.name: open_palm_rotation_sweep
sequences.description: open palm rotating 0 to 180 degrees in the image plane

sequences.name: inverted_fist
sequences.description: fist pointing down and rotating back up stays zero

sequences.name: open_palm_approach
sequences.description: open palm growing from 20 px to 120 px palm width

sequences.name: jitter_four_fingers
sequences.description: four fingers with 3 px landmark noise on every frame; the count never flickers

sequences.name: real_webcam_open_palm
sequences.description: recorded open palm, mirrored copy afterwards

sequences.name: real_tilted_palm_and_fist
sequences.description: recorded tilted palm, then the recorded fist

sequences.name: real_palm_from_behind_small
sequences.description: recorded palm photographed from behind, shrunk to a 24 px palm

sequences.name: transition_one_to_five
sequences.description: 1 to 5 passing through 2, 3 and 4 held three frames each: every step commits
